title: Elliptic-billiard invariant k_{204}
statement: Fix an ellipse with center $O$ and foci $f_1,f_2$, and let $P=(P_i)_{i=1}^N$ range over its Poncelet family of $N$-periodic billiard orbits tangent to a fixed confocal caustic. Let $P'$ be the outer polygon formed by consecutive tangent intersections and $P''$ the inner polygon of caustic tangency points; write $A,A',A''$ for their areas. Drop perpendiculars from $M$ to the sides of $P$ and let $A_M$ be the area of the resulting pedal polygon. Prove that, for $N\equiv2\pmod4$, every $M$, the quantity $A/A_M$ is constant as $P$ varies through the family. The source labels this assertion invariant code k_{204}.
source_scope: Table3 k204 stable across arXivv11 and final; original-side-line pedal; signed area; least period2mod4; strict confocal ellipse pair; fixed arbitrary M; quotient only where denominator nonzero.
